visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up montage of the finished Spanish Octopus and Spicy Sausage dish, highlighting the textures of the octopus tentacles, shrimp, and seared sausage with green herbs. (2) Hands pour olive oil into a black frying pan, followed by adding whole shrimp heads to the sizzling oil. (3) The chef uses tongs to add sliced rounds of Spanish spicy sausage into the pan alongside the shrimp heads, turning them occasionally. (4) Shrimp heads are removed from the pan, and the sausage slices are seared until golden brown on both sides. (5) Minced garlic is added to the aromatic oil and stirred until it reaches a crispy, golden texture. (6) Dried red chilies are tossed into the garlic oil mixture. (7) Several small octopus tentacles are added to the pan and sauteed with the garlic and chilies. (8) Raw white shrimp are added to the mix as the ingredients are tossed together. (9) Seasonings of salt, pepper, and fresh basil leaves are incorporated into the dish. (10) The cooked seafood and sausage mixture is plated onto a white serving dish. (11) Final presentation of the dish with a call to action overlay.
